shared_elements: bilateral symmetry about a vertical axis
justification: Both organise their decoration around a vertical axis with a prominent concentric disc at roughly waist height above a broad band running across the body, which is the single most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge entirely: A is a flat, saturated polychrome drawing of two mirrored, richly costumed figures with faces, ornaments and handheld objects, while B is a weathered monolithic stone with faint, low-relief geometric marks and no colour, narrative or paired figures.
